notes:
Summary: Elmcrest runs customer support for a mid-size payments processor (card acquiring + payouts). Extremely security/compliance sensitive (PCI scope + some PHI from merchant interactions). Looking to replace brittle templates + macros with an agent-assist layer that does: quick ticket summarization, next-action suggestions, tool-calling into Zendesk/ServiceNow, and live assistance during call spikes. They want VPC/private control plane and strict audit log retention.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-02-20: Intro call with AE (Sofia) + head of support ops (M. Alvarez). High-level requirements captured.
- 2026-02-25: Deep dive with infra + security (SE Deepak attended). Discussed VPC topology and KMS integration. Fireflies: ff_20260225_poc_scoping.
- 2026-03-02: Demo of hosted inference / routing concepts for product team. Live notes: need guaranteed throughput for 1.2k concurrent agents during peak. Fireflies: ff_20260302_elmcrest_eval.
- 2026-03-08: Security team emailed initial PCI & HIPAA questionnaire. Gmail thread: thread-16622-security-questions.
- 2026-03-10: SE follow-up on KV-cache retention windows (requested 24-72h retention, encrypted at rest).

Workload + technical requirements (shorthand):
- Primary workloads: agent-assist (real-time suggestions, 95th% latency <200ms), ticket summarization (batch nightly), automated tool-calling (function calls to Zendesk + internal CRM), rerank for knowledge base.
- Scale: ~1,200 concurrent active agents; burst factor x2 during incidents. Expected 6M messages/month.
- Latency SLOs: real-time assist 95% < 200ms, token cost sensitivity moderate but reliability > cheapest model.
- Model preferences: prefer open models with Redwood-verified performance; willing to use quantized variants for fallback; want pinned model versions and reproducible rollouts.
- Routing/fallback: must support policy-based routing by region and capacity; automatic fallback to lower-cost quantized variant with traceability.
- Caching: prefix/KV cache for 24–72h, but audit copies of cache writes kept per legal retention.

Security/compliance specifics (from security call):
- VPC private control plane; no production PII/PCI traffic to shared public plane.
- SSO via SAML (Okta); test cert needed for PoC.
- KMS/HSM integration mandatory; keys must be customer-managed.
- Audit logs retention: retention controls configurable, immutable append-only export for 7 years for PCI audit.
- SOC2 + ISO27001 required; Redwood security FAQ referenced.
- Data residency: US-only production.

POC plan (agreed scope):
- Phase 1 (2 weeks): Demo private routing + latency report on synthetic trace; integrate to sandbox Zendesk; basic ticket summarization.
- Phase 2 (3 weeks): Live agent-assist pilot with 50 agents behind VPC; verify SSO + KMS integration; run surge test to 2x baseline.
- Acceptance criteria: 95th% latency <200ms under pilot load; correct SSO auth flow; encrypted logs exported to Elmcrest S3; security questionnaire answers signed off.

Quotes / call snippets: "We need to be sure nothing touches a shared plane when handling cardholder data — that is non-negotiable." — M. Alvarez (Head of Support Ops)

Open items / immediate blockers:
- Legal wants final PCI scoping (list of fields that will be processed by models).
- Security needs a sample HSM/KMS integration doc + playbook. Deepak to deliver sample by 2026-03-12.
- Okta test cert delayed until 2026-03-15 which pushes full pilot by ~1 week.

Next steps (short):
- Deliver PoC plan + cost estimates (Sofia) by 2026-03-12.
- SE to send HSM/KMS integration example (Deepak) by 2026-03-12.
- Schedule SSO token-exchange demo w/ Okta (target 2026-03-17).
